headline.reading: 17.2% was measured on the affine-CRC32 placements PR #1393 replaced the next morning. On today's positioner the real-corpus island is at or below the fixture, so the 'more than twice the fixture' gap is absent rather than explained. The committed order-and-caps README table was never updated when that PR re-ran its own report; the report JSON already carries these numbers.

crossIsland.claim: the two islands differ in what the dispersion fix bought BECAUSE they differ in plants per cell, and in nothing else the pipeline knows about

realCorpus.unit: percentage points of placements delivering zero pixels

fixture.unit: percentage points of placements delivering zero pixels

the top-right corner reproduces the published 17.2% to within one placement
checks.detail: 30 of 180 = 16.7% (published: 31 of 180 = 17.2%); the one-placement gap is the UAT flower spiral, which LEGACY_AFFINE does not restore

checks.check: TODAY the real-corpus island is at or BELOW the fixture — the 'more than twice the fixture' gap is absent, not merely explained
checks.detail: real 6.1% vs fixture 7.0%

and the dispersion fix is split rather than credited whole
